skills.reference_body: Define intended user, body area, product form, desired sensory profile, ingredient philosophy, allergens, contraindications, packaging, stability, preservation, labeling, and target market before proposing a concept. Separate cosmetic positioning from medical claims. Verify supplier documentation, usage limits, compatibility, sanitation, batch records, and applicable regulatory requirements. Require qualified formulation, stability, microbial, packaging, and safety review before sale or use.
skills.asset_body:
# Skincare Concept Brief

## Audience, use area, form, benefit language, owner, and approval

| Ingredient role | Candidate | Supplier evidence | Usage range | Constraint | Decision |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Sensory target, allergens, preservation, packaging, labeling, and claims

## Prototype, stability, microbial, compatibility, safety, and user tests

## Assumptions, qualified review, version, decision, and next gate
skills.recovery: If intended use, ingredient identity, supplier limits, allergens, preservation, stability, safety, or regulatory status is unresolved, label the work as a concept only. Do not provide production authorization, therapeutic claims, or a sellable formula.
skills.recovery_scenario: Skincare safety or formulation evidence is incomplete.

skills.reference_body: Translate the desired body-care experience into a documented concept covering product form, application, audience, sensory attributes, natural-oil and herb preferences, ingredient functions, allergens, fragrance, packaging, stability, preservation, labeling, and claims. Distinguish an inspiration brief from a validated formula. Check supplier specifications and require controlled prototypes, sanitation, compatibility, stability, microbial, safety, and regulatory review before production.
skills.asset_body:
# Body Care Concept Brief

## Product, audience, use, experience, owner, and approval

| Component role | Candidate | Evidence | Range | Risk or constraint | Decision |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Texture, aroma, application, allergens, preservation, package, and claims

## Prototype, sanitation, stability, compatibility, safety, and acceptance tests

## Qualified review, assumptions, version, status, and next action
skills.recovery: If product use, ingredient identity, usage limits, allergy risks, preservation need, packaging compatibility, or safety evidence is unresolved, keep the output at concept stage. Do not infer that natural ingredients are automatically safe.
skills.recovery_scenario: Body-care formulation or safety evidence is incomplete.

skills.reference_body: Build the brief from the verified formula, ingredient nomenclature and order, net contents, business identity, contact information, batch traceability, directions, warnings, allergens, claims, package dimensions, legibility, language, jurisdiction, and channel requirements. Never convert marketing intent into an unsubstantiated drug claim. Treat the brief as preparation for qualified legal and regulatory review, and reconcile it against the released formula and artwork before printing.
skills.asset_body:
# Cosmetic Labeling Brief

## Product, formula version, jurisdiction, channel, package, owner, and reviewer

| Label panel | Required content | Source evidence | Artwork location | Review status |
|---|---|---|---|---|

## Ingredient declaration, net contents, identity, directions, warnings, and traceability

## Claims substantiation, legibility, language, barcode, and package constraints

## Formula reconciliation, qualified review, proof approval, version, and release
skills.recovery: If the released formula, ingredient order, jurisdiction, package area, warnings, claims evidence, or qualified review is missing, do not release artwork. Mark unresolved content and retain the prior approved label until reconciliation is complete.
skills.recovery_scenario: Cosmetic label evidence or review is incomplete.

skills.reference_body: Plan only from an approved master formula and batch scale. Verify raw-material identity, supplier lot, quantity, expiration, storage, equipment, sanitation, personnel, environmental controls, order of addition, temperatures, mixing, hold times, in-process checks, yield, packaging, labeling, retain samples, deviations, and release authority. Use controlled units and calculations, preserve traceability, and quarantine any batch with unresolved identity, process, or quality evidence.
skills.asset_body:

## Product, master formula, target batch, date, operator, equipment, and approval

| Material | Supplier lot | Required qty | Actual qty | Verification | Initials |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Sanitation, order of addition, temperature, mixing, timing, and in-process checks

## Yield, fill, package, label, retain sample, deviation, and reconciliation

## Quality review, quarantine or release, traceability, and archive
skills.recovery: If the master formula, scaling calculation, material identity, sanitation, equipment status, process limit, or release authority is unresolved, stop production and quarantine affected materials or product. Never improvise a safety-critical substitution.
skills.recovery_scenario: Beauty batch controls or traceability are incomplete.

skills.reference_body: Design from occasion, recipient, budget, product compatibility, dimensions, weight, fragility, leakage, scent transfer, allergens, temperature sensitivity, presentation, brand rules, personalization, inventory, assembly labor, shipping, accessibility, sustainability, and delivery date. Confirm every component and claim, protect products in transit, and create a repeatable bill of materials, assembly sequence, inspection criteria, substitutions, and customer approval gate.

skills.recovery: If product compatibility, allergen communication, dimensions, stock, shipping protection, personalization proof, cost, or approval is unresolved, keep the box in draft. Do not promise a delivery date or substitute products without authorization.

skills.reference_body: Calculate wholesale pricing from verified direct material, labor, packaging, overhead, spoilage, payment, marketplace, freight, taxes, minimum order, case pack, lead time, capacity, target margin, retailer margin, and channel restrictions. Distinguish margin from markup and test discounts, samples, returns, damage, late payment, and shipping scenarios. Document assumptions, approval, effective dates, review triggers, and exceptions without exposing confidential costs unnecessarily.
skills.asset_body:

| Product | Unit cost | Wholesale price | Gross margin | MOQ or case | Lead time |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Discounts, samples, freight, payment, returns, damage, taxes, and channel rules

## Break-even, capacity, sensitivity, retailer margin, and exception tests

## Approved price list, confidentiality, version, review trigger, and archive
skills.recovery: If unit cost, margin target, capacity, freight responsibility, payment terms, taxes, or approval is unresolved, do not issue a binding quote. Mark estimates and expiration dates clearly and preserve the last approved price list.
skills.recovery_scenario: Wholesale economics or commercial terms are incomplete.

skills.reference_body: Score suppliers using comparable periods and verified purchase orders, acknowledgments, receipts, inspections, defects, certificates, lot traceability, responsiveness, lead times, price changes, service, sustainability, and corrective actions. Define metric formulas, weights, minimum sample size, data confidence, severity, and escalation thresholds before scoring. Separate objective facts from observations, protect confidential information, and require human review for qualification, suspension, or termination decisions.
skills.asset_body:
# Supplier Performance Scorecard

## Supplier, category, period, owner, sample, method, and confidence

| Metric | Weight | Target | Actual | Evidence | Weighted result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Delivery, quality, documentation, traceability, service, cost, and risk

## Defects, corrective actions, trends, exceptions, and comparison limits

## Review decision, actions, owner, due date, approval, and next assessment
skills.recovery: If source records, metric definitions, sample size, severity, or comparability is inadequate, do not publish a definitive supplier rank. Issue a provisional finding, request evidence, and escalate consequential sourcing decisions to authorized reviewers.
skills.recovery_scenario: Supplier evidence is insufficient for a reliable score.

skills.reference_body: Analyze reviews with authorized, privacy-conscious data collection; preserve source, date, product, variant, rating, channel, language, and verification status. Remove or restrict personal information, distinguish representative themes from anecdotes, account for duplicates and incentives, and quantify coverage and uncertainty. Separate product, fulfillment, support, expectation, safety, and preference issues. Never fabricate quotations or infer protected traits, diagnoses, or customer intent.
skills.asset_body:
# Customer Review Analysis

## Scope, products, channels, period, owner, volume, and confidence

| Theme | Count or rate | Sentiment | Evidence | Severity | Recommended action |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Product, fulfillment, support, expectation, safety, and preference findings

## Bias, duplicates, incentives, privacy, coverage, and limitations

## Priorities, owners, experiments, measures, approvals, and review date
skills.recovery: If review provenance, permission, privacy treatment, sample coverage, duplicate handling, or quotation accuracy is unresolved, pause publication. Report only supported aggregate observations and escalate product-safety signals for qualified review.
skills.recovery_scenario: Customer review data quality or privacy is unresolved.

skills.reference_body: Plan retention activity from a defined business objective, eligible audience, lawful contact basis, consent and suppression status, purchase behavior, lifecycle stage, channel, frequency, offer economics, inventory, capacity, message, claims, personalization, accessibility, timing, attribution, stop rules, and owner approval. Protect customer data, avoid manipulative urgency or sensitive inference, test with a controlled segment, and measure incrementality rather than vanity metrics alone.

skills.recovery: If consent, suppression, segment logic, offer margin, inventory, claims, personalization, or approval is unresolved, do not activate the campaign. Preserve normal customer service and exclude ambiguous records until validated.
skills.recovery_scenario: Retention audience or campaign controls are incomplete.

Separate requirements from implementation, prototype critical views, test role access and edge cases, and establish acceptance, monitoring, change control, and rollback.
